name: ibis budget Singapore Joo Chiat
short_description: A 90-room, 2-star budget hotel on Joo Chiat Road in the Peranakan heritage district, near Marine Parade MRT.
ai_summary: ibis budget Singapore Joo Chiat sits at 219 Joo Chiat Road in Singapore's Peranakan heritage district, within walking distance of Marine Parade MRT and surrounded by preserved shophouses, cafes, and local eateries. The five-storey, 90-room property was formerly branded The Fragrance Hotel - Joo Chiat before its rebrand to ibis budget under Accor. TripAdvisor shows a 3.5/5 rating from 413 reviews (ranked around #155 of 373 Singapore hotels), with guests repeatedly praising cleanliness and value while noting small rooms and thin walls between them. Multiple independently confirmed YouTube creators have posted room tours of the property. The hotel does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme.

core_facts.elite_notes: This hotel does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme, per its own Accor listing; ALL member rates may still apply but no points-earning or elite benefits are offered.

faqs.question: Is ibis budget Singapore Joo Chiat part of the ALL loyalty programme?
faqs.answer: No -- despite the ibis budget/Accor branding, this hotel's own Accor listing confirms it does not participate in the ALL - Accor Live Limitless loyalty programme, so members cannot earn or redeem points or elite benefits here, though ALL member rates may still apply.

faqs.question: What neighborhood is ibis budget Singapore Joo Chiat in?
faqs.answer: It's on Joo Chiat Road in Singapore's Peranakan heritage district, within walking distance of Marine Parade MRT and surrounded by preserved shophouses, cafes, and local eateries -- a distinctive, culturally rich alternative to staying in the Geylang cluster of sister ibis budget properties.
